notes: QA recommends pass for WP-038 with no rework issues. The direct art integration is technically stable, scoped, and readable enough for BK manual owner play. Residual risk to watch in playtest: Section 2 background detail may visually compete with foreground gameplay cues, but current labels, warning rect, distinct art roles, and explicit gameplay nodes keep it acceptable for prototype-owner review. This review does not approve final art direction, production asset usage, launch/public use, Learning Card promotion, push, merge, deployment, or Phase 4B closeout.
